record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> on Neginoth<WH05058>, A Psalm<WH04210> <FI>or<Fi> Song<WH07892>.<Fo><Fo> God<WH0430> be merciful<WH02603><WTH8799> unto us, and bless<WH01288><WTH8762> us; <FI>and<Fi>  cause his face<WH06440> to shine<WH0215><WTH8686> upon us; Selah<WH05542>. <RF>chief...: or, overseer<Rf> <RF>upon: Heb. with<Rf>

<FI> Then<Fi> shall the earth<WH0776> yield<WH05414><WTH8804> her increase<WH02981>; <FI>and<Fi> God<WH0430>, <FI>even<Fi> our own God<WH0430>, shall bless<WH01288><WTH8762> us.
